identified_issues: False-negative failure alert generated by monitoring system treating synchronous HTTP 504 gateway timeout as definitive transaction failure
Premature rollback recommendation conflicting with authoritative bilateral clearing statement
Outbound gateway cached status remained CALLBACK_PENDING_TIMEOUT without automated resolution from out-of-band clearing reconciliation feeds
evidence: Clearing Bank SFTP bilateral statement (CAMT.053 / MT940) explicitly lists REF=TX-8102-EUR with CLEARING_ID=EBA-STEP2-9948102 as STATUS=SETTLED for EUR 14,850,000.00 at VAL_DATETIME=2026-10-06T08:15:02Z
Bilateral statement explicitly reports REJECTION_RECORDS: NONE, confirming no rejection or cancellation occurred
Settlement timestamp on the clearing network (08:15:02Z) preceded the HTTP 504 gateway timeout (08:15:03.205Z), verifying that the instruction was processed before connection failure
Ledger Core record reflects COMMITTED state matching the settled transaction parameters exactly (TX-8102-EUR, EUR 14,850,000.00)
recommended_action: Dismiss the rollback alert; reconcile and update the gateway transaction status from CALLBACK_PENDING_TIMEOUT to SETTLED based on the authoritative CAMT.053 statement, and update monitoring logic to await end-of-window reconciliation before declaring settlement failures on transport timeouts.
